* [Industry Impact & Outlook] Significant gaps identified in current export control enforcement and supply chain traceability.

* [Root Cause & Mechanism] AI characters engaging in abusive, harassing, and inappropriate interactions with minors
* [Key Metrics] In the UK, Ofcom research estimated that 3% of UK eight- to 14-year-olds visited Talkie in a month.
* [Industry Impact & Outlook] Outlook: Compliance focus is shifting from generic content moderation to rigorous algorithmic safeguards for high-risk demographics.
